sans.$description: Every control, label and message. Lamina Sans is Source Sans 3, renamed in @laminapdf/fonts because its licence reserves the name 'Source'; the fallback face is Arial sized to match it

serif.$description: Titles: file name, inspector and sheet titles, headings, outline rows

page.$description: Page mockups only, never in UI

mono.$description: Code, object trees, payloads, licence keys

page-heading.$description: h1 of settings and list pages

heading.$description: Section headings in panels and settings

document-name.$description: File name in the top bar

input-large.$description: Palette input; every text input on touch

body.$description: Default UI text, inputs, palette rows, mode switcher

control.$description: Rail tabs, secondary toolbar, selection toolbar, small buttons

label.$description: Field labels in the inspector and forms

caption.$description: Metadata, status bar, palette group names, thumbnail numbers

tab-label.$description: Phone bottom bar and action bar labels

duration-toast.$description: How long a toast stays (paused while hovered or focused)

duration-pill-fade.$description: Page pill fades this long after scrolling stops

z-modal.$description: Scrim with the palette or a dialog

z-popover.$description: Menus, popovers and tooltips, portalled above whatever opened them
